envelope.description: Team gate callers: make them await-ready

body.title: Team gate callers: make them await-ready
body.summary: In the callers of the team gate chain (gates.ts at :641 and :930, review/resolve.ts, review/run-artifact.ts, review-step verdicts, workflow-rpc.ts, the workflow-step and build-step phases, resume.ts, run-meta.ts) make the enclosing functions asynchronous where needed and await each gate call. The gate functions are still synchronous, so awaiting changes no value and every test stays green.
acceptanceChecks: every caller listed in the LLD awaits its gate call and returns the same outcome as before
the daemon method key-set cases in handler.test.ts and handler-runtime.test.ts still pass

tests.name: team-gate-callers.test.ts: each listed caller awaits its gate call and returns the same outcome; handler.test.ts and handler-runtime.test.ts still pass
